in_marathi.name: Devagya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devagya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devi, the goddess of gods, is the source of all existence, consciousness, and power in the universe. Devagya is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘deva’ meaning god and ‘gya’ meaning knowledge or wisdom. This name represents a strong connection to the divine and the pursuit of spiritual knowledge.
